EXODUSER: HELL LORD is an action RPG in which combat controls, bullet parrying, chain traversal, skill combinations and equipment builds are closely connected. We want to use Early Access to improve combat balance, build variety, boss patterns and the user experience based on real player feedback across different play styles and combat situations.

We plan to remain in Early Access until the game's core content and systems are sufficiently complete and combat balance and stability are ready for a full release. The duration may vary depending on development progress and player feedback.

For the full version, we plan to add more areas, stages, bosses, enemies, skills and equipment options, and expand the existing systems. We also plan to keep improving combat balance, build variety, the interface, performance and overall polish. These plans may change as development progresses and in response to player feedback.

The current version includes the game's core combat systems: real-time hack-and-slash combat, parrying bullet patterns according to their colors and patterns, high-speed chain traversal, active skills and skill combinations, equipment farming and character builds. Multiple combat areas, enemies and bosses are already implemented. We are continuing to improve content, balance, presentation and quality-of-life features during development.
We plan to determine pricing during Early Access based on development progress and the scale of added content. The price may change at full release, and we will announce any decisions in advance.

We plan to gather feedback through the Steam Community and from players on combat balance, difficulty, skill and equipment builds, boss patterns, performance and usability. We will review bug reports and play experiences and continue incorporating feedback that helps guide development.
